intro: Chapter 26 covers the levels of psychiatric care: how the system of community care arose, how to match a patient to inpatient, partial hospital, intensive outpatient, outpatient or residential care (Table 26-1), voluntary and involuntary admission, length of stay (Figure 26-1) and discharge planning. Update boxes add the LOCUS tool and the Philippine Mental Health Act.
objectives: Name the five main levels of care and the factors that separate them.
List the indications for inpatient admission, including involuntary admission.
Tell partial hospital treatment from intensive outpatient treatment.
State the requirements for safe outpatient care.
Describe who fits residential care and what it aims for.
